AI.conclusion: 该方法为描述一维流体动力学系统（特别是超扩散输运等非常规现象）提供了自洽、通用的理论框架。

title: Quasiparticle interference as a tool to study quantum materials
comment: Review about quasiparticle interference imaging, with 103 pages and 21 figures
summary: To understand the properties of quantum materials a detailed knowledge of the material's low energy electronic structure is key. Details of the electronic structure drive the ground state through electronic instabilities, electronic correlation effects, new electronic orders or just the absence of electronic states near the Fermi energy - making a realistic and detailed understanding crucial to be able to control and design properties of quantum materials. The past 25 years have seen a significant improvement in experimental techniques to observe the true electronic structure, in particular in techniques such as Angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) where energy resolutions of 2meV are routinely achievable now, which however is limited to zero magnetic field and only provides information about the occupied states. Scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) achieves a significantly better energy resolution <100$μ$eV and can operate at temperatures well below 50mK and in magnetic fields. While per se a real-space technique, by imaging quasiparticle interference (QPI) STM can also provide information about the electronic structure. This technique has been used over the past decades to study a wide range of quantum materials to understand correlated electron behaviour. Recent theoretical progress now enables routine modelling of QPI, a key requirement to interpret the complex data. Here, we review the principles of QPI, its origin, experimental detection, and the physical insight gained from the study of QPI and possible future directions for this technique.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了准粒子干涉（QPI）成像技术的基本原理、实验检测方法、在量子材料电子结构研究中的应用及未来发展方向。
AI.motivation: 理解量子材料的低能电子结构对揭示其基态性质（如电子不稳定性、关联效应、新电子序等）至关重要。尽管ARPES和STM等实验技术已取得显著进步，但QPI作为一种从实空间获取电子结构信息的技术，其原理和应用仍需系统梳理。
AI.method: 回顾QPI技术的起源、基本原理（通过STM成像准粒子干涉图案反推电子结构）、实验检测方法，以及近年来理论建模方面的进展，实现了对复杂QPI数据的常规化解释。
AI.result: QPI技术已在多种量子材料中成功应用，揭示了关联电子行为；理论建模的进步使得从复杂QPI数据中提取电子结构信息成为可能。
AI.conclusion: QPI是一种强大的电子结构探测手段，能在极低温和强磁场下提供超越ARPES的能量分辨率，未来有望在量子材料研究中发挥更重要的作用。

title: Quasi-Two-Dimensional Quantum Antiferromagnetism in the Distorted Honeycomb Compound KCuIn(PO4)2
comment: Published in Physica Status Solidi (RRL) - Rapid Research Letters
summary: We investigate the electronic structure and magnetic properties of the distorted honeycomb lattice compound KCuInP2O8 through a combination of experimental measurements, first principles calculations and quantum monte carlo simulations. Density functional theory calculations within the GGA+U framework establishes KCuInP2O8 as an indirect gap insulator with Cu2+ local moments and finite magnetocrystalline anisotropy arising from spin orbit coupling. A microscopic evaluation of magnetic exchange interactions using the magnetic force theorem reveals a pronounced hierarchy of couplings, with the next nearest neighbor interaction dominating over the nearest neighbor exchange, while interlayer couplings remain negligible. This exchange hierarchy naturally maps the system onto weakly coupled antiferromagnetic spin chains embedded in a distorted honeycomb lattice. Motivated by the ab initio estimated exchange interactions, we construct an effective spin half Hamiltonian and investigate its magnetic response using large scale quantum Monte Carlo simulations. The calculated temperature dependent susceptibility and field dependent magnetization quantitatively reproduce the experimental behavior and capture key signatures of low dimensional quantum magnetism, including a broad susceptibility maximum and a field induced saturation at low temperatures. Our results establish KCuInP2O8 as a quasi-two-dimensional quantum antiferromagnet composed of coupled spin chains, providing a consistent theoretical framework that links electronic structure, exchange interactions, and collective magnetic behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验、第一性原理计算和量子蒙特卡洛模拟，系统研究了扭曲蜂窝状晶格化合物KCuInP2O8的电子结构和磁性质，发现其具有独特的次近邻交换作用主导的磁耦合层次，表现为由弱耦合反铁磁自旋链组成的准二维量子反铁磁体。
AI.motivation: 探究扭曲蜂窝状晶格化合物KCuInP2O8的电子结构和磁性质，理解其低维量子磁性的微观机制。
AI.method: 结合实验测量、GGA+U框架下的密度泛函理论计算、磁力定理评估交换作用，以及大规模量子蒙特卡洛模拟构建有效自旋1/2哈密顿量。
AI.result: 发现该材料是间接带隙绝缘体，具有Cu²⁺局域磁矩和自旋轨道耦合引起的有限磁晶各向异性；交换作用呈现显著层次性，次近邻相互作用占主导，层间耦合可忽略；模拟的磁化率和磁化强度定量复现了实验数据。
AI.conclusion: KCuInP2O8是一种由耦合自旋链组成的准二维量子反铁磁体，研究建立了电子结构、交换作用与集体磁行为之间的统一理论框架。

title: Unbiased Diffusion Monte Carlo for non local operators
summary: We propose a new mathematically exact method for computing unbiased Diffusion Monte Carlo (DMC) estimates of non-local operators. We demonstrate that the current state-of- the-art technique, Forward Walking, is only exact for local quantities and fails to yield unbiased results for the non-local components of reduced density matrices (RDMs). Our method significantly outperforms Forward Walking, as shown in two systems: in the symmetric Hubbard dimer it yields a pure 1RDM; while in the Helium atom it will give an unbiased 1RDM in the limits of zero time step and infinite walkers.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种精确计算非局域算符扩散蒙特卡罗无偏估计的新方法，克服了传统Forward Walking方法仅适用于局域量且对非局域分量（如约化密度矩阵）失效的问题，在Hubbard二聚体和氦原子体系中验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有Forward Walking方法只能对局域量给出无偏估计，而对于非局域算符（如约化密度矩阵的非局域分量）会产生有偏结果，因此需要一种新的精确方法来解决这一局限性。
AI.method: 提出了一种数学上精确的新方法，用于计算扩散蒙特卡洛（DMC）中非局域算符的无偏估计，通过与Forward Walking方法在对称Hubbard二聚体和氦原子体系中进行对比验证。
AI.result: 在对称Hubbard二聚体中，新方法得到了纯的1RDM（一阶约化密度矩阵）；在氦原子中，在零时间步长和无限walker极限下得到了无偏的1RDM，且整体表现显著优于Forward Walking方法。
AI.conclusion: 新方法在数学上精确且无偏，能有效处理非局域算符，弥补了Forward Walking方法的不足，为非局域量的DMC计算提供了更可靠的途径。

title: Fractional parametric resonance in spintronic diodes
summary: Parametric pumping is a powerful tool for the excitation, amplification, and processing of oscillations and waves of different nature. In general, parametric resonance can occur when the pumping frequency $f_p$ and eigenfrequency of a linear mode (or wave) $f_0$ satisfy the relation $f_p$=2$f_0$/n (n=1,2,3,...). While such parametric resonance is well known in mechanical, superconductive, and quantum systems, in magnetic and spintronic systems only the lowest (n=1) parametric resonance at double the spin wave mode frequency $f_p$=2$f_0$ was thoroughly studied and explored. Here, using a theoretical analysis based on both micromagnetic simulations and an analytical model, we show the emergence of resonances at fractional frequencies $f_p$=2$f_0$/n (with n>10) in spintronic diodes driven by the simultaneous action of ac spin-transfer torque (STT, current densities < $10^6$ A/cm2) and voltage-controlled magnetic anisotropy (VCMA, effective anisotropy fields < 50 mT). The analytical model shows that parametric magnetization dynamics is irreducible to the standard Mathieu model of a parametric oscillator and demonstrates the crucial role of VCMA-driven mode frequency modulation: together with parametric coupling, it results in higher-order odd (n=3,5,7,...) fractional resonances, observed above certain VCMA pumping threshold, while simultaneous action with linear STT drive produces thresholdless even (n=4,6,8,...) resonances. This higher-order parametric dynamics is not restricted to VCMA pumping and opens new directions for the application of spintronic diodes for nonlinear signal processing and electromagnetic energy harvesting.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论分析、微磁模拟和解析模型，发现在自旋电子二极管中，当同时施加交流自旋转移矩（STT）和电压控制磁各向异性（VCMA）时，可以激发分数频率参数共振（fp=2f0/n, n>10），并揭示了高阶奇次（n=3,5,7...）和偶次（n=4,6,8...）共振的不同机制。
AI.motivation: 在磁性和自旋电子系统中，以往只深入研究了最低阶（n=1）的参数共振（fp=2f0），而更高阶的分数频率参数共振（fp=2f0/n, n>1）尚未被探索。本文旨在揭示这些高阶共振的存在条件及其物理机制。
AI.method: 采用基于微磁模拟和解析模型的理论分析方法，研究在交流STT（电流密度<10^6 A/cm²）和VCMA（有效各向异性场<50 mT）共同驱动下自旋电子二极管的磁化动力学。
AI.result: 发现并解释了高阶分数频率参数共振（n>10）的存在。解析模型表明，该参数磁化动力学不可简化为标准Mathieu模型；VCMA驱动的模式频率调制与参数耦合共同作用产生高阶奇次共振（n=3,5,7,...），而线性STT驱动与VCMA联合作用则产生无阈值偶次共振（n=4,6,8,...）。
AI.conclusion: 高阶参数动力学不仅限于VCMA泵浦，为自旋电子二极管在非线性信号处理和电磁能量收集中的应用开辟了新方向。

title: Extreme First-Passage Time of Many Interacting Particles
comment: 6 pages. Comments are highly appreciated. Supplemental Materials will be uploaded prior to the formal submission
summary: Extreme first-passage events are broadly relevant to biological, chemical, and physical processes in which the first successful arrival determines the outcome. Existing theories are confined to noninteracting searchers. Interacting extreme-statistics problems are notoriously difficult because correlations destroy probability factorization. We establish a general framework for interacting extreme search. A no-go theorem shows that broad classes of bounded interactions cannot beat the $1/\ln N$ extreme timescale of $N$ independent Brownian searchers, and complementary upper bounds prove that this scale is exact for broad classes of repulsive interactions. We then identify two sharp mechanisms beyond the logarithmic class and derive a unified interaction-driven acceleration limit. In particular, deterministic pairwise interaction can at most reduce the extreme search time to order $1/N$, while stochastic pairwise forcing attains $1/(N\ln N)$. Our results separate acceleration due to statistical redundancy from that generated by coherent many-body transport or amplified fluctuations, deepening our understanding of interacting stochastic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了交互作用下极端首次通过时间的一般理论框架，证明有界相互作用无法突破独立布朗搜索者的1/ln N时间尺度，并识别出两种超越对数类机制的加速机制。
AI.motivation: 现有极端统计理论仅限于非相互作用搜索者，而相互作用极端统计问题因相关性破坏概率分解而极其困难，亟需建立一般性理论框架。
AI.method: 通过建立"无go定理"证明有界相互作用无法超越1/ln N尺度，利用上界证明排斥相互作用的精确性，并识别确定性成对相互作用和随机成对强迫两种加速机制。
AI.result: 确定性成对相互作用可将极端搜索时间降至1/N量级，随机成对强迫可降至1/(N ln N)量级。
AI.conclusion: 分离了统计冗余产生的加速与相干多体输运或放大涨落产生的加速，深化了对相互作用随机系统的理解。

title: Ionic Diffusion Properties of Rare-Earth High-Entropy Oxides from a Machine-Learned Interatomic Potential
summary: Rare-earth high-entropy oxides (RE-HEOs) have emerged as a promising class of functional ceramics for solid-state electrochemical applications due to their chemical complexity, structural tunability, and potential for fast oxygen-ion transport. In this work, we investigate oxygen diffusion in ceria-based RE-HEOs of the form Ce$_x$(YLaPrSm)$_{1-x}$O$_{2-δ}$ using classical molecular dynamics simulations driven by the Crystal Hamiltonian Graph Neural Network (CHGNet) machine-learned interatomic potential. To improve predictive accuracy for lanthanide-containing systems, we benchmark three CHGNet variants, including a fine-tuned r$^2$SCAN-trained model, against targeted density functional theory (DFT) data that explicitly include f-valence electrons. Simulations across temperature, Ce content, oxygen vacancy concentration, and both fluorite and bixbyite structures reveal that oxygen transport in RE-HEOs is governed by the interplay of two factors: the concentration of mobile vacancies and the local cation environment through which they hop. At fixed composition, ionic conductivity exhibits a non-monotonic dependence on vacancy concentration, with optimal diffusion occurring at moderate vacancy levels and reduced mobility at higher concentrations. Increasing Ce content lowers migration activation energies and enhances diffusivity through low-barrier diffusion networks built from Ce-Ce and Ce-Y edges. Analysis of individual oxygen hopping events provides atomistic insight into how local chemical environments and short-range cation ordering govern transport in high-entropy oxides. Overall, this work demonstrates that machine-learned interatomic potentials can resolve composition-structure-transport relationships in chemically complex oxides, and identifies active pathways through which compositional tuning can enhance oxygen-ion conductivity in RE-HEO materials.

AI.tldr: 本文利用机器学习势函数（CHGNet）结合分子动力学模拟，系统研究了铈基稀土高熵氧化物Ce_x(YLaPrSm)_{1-x}O_{2-δ}中的氧离子输运行为，揭示了氧空位浓度与局域阳离子环境共同决定离子电导率的机制，并发现Ce含量增加可通过构建低势垒扩散网络提升氧离子迁移率。
AI.motivation: 稀土高熵氧化物在固态电化学应用中潜力巨大，但其氧离子输运机制尚不清晰，传统DFT方法难以高效模拟复杂组分体系，亟需借助机器学习势函数实现高通量、原子级别的输运机制解析。
AI.method: 采用CHGNet机器学习原子间势进行经典分子动力学模拟，对比三种CHGNet变体（含微调r²SCAN训练模型），并引入含f价电子的DFT数据校准；系统扫描温度、Ce含量、氧空位浓度及萤石/方铁锰矿结构，分析氧跳跃事件。
AI.result: 氧离子电导率随空位浓度呈非单调变化，中等空位浓度下最优；增加Ce含量降低迁移活化能，Ce-Ce和Ce-Y边构成低势垒扩散网络；局域化学环境和短程阳离子有序性显著影响氧跳跃行为。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习势函数能够有效解析高熵氧化物的组成-结构-输运关系，通过调控Ce含量和空位浓度可定向增强稀土高熵氧化物的氧离子电导率。

title: Orbital Embedding and the Physical Definition of Quantum Geometry
summary: The Quantum Geometric Tensor, encompassing the quantum metric and Berry curvature, is a central concept in modern condensed matter physics. However, its standard calculation via $k$-derivatives of the Bloch projector conceals a fundamental ambiguity regarding the choice of unit-cell convention, specifically in the treatment of intra-cell orbital positions (i.e., with or without the orbital position $e^{ikx_α}$). We resolve this inconsistency by introducing a convention-independent physical QGT defined via a covariant derivative that explicitly incorporates the full position operator. We demonstrate that this formulation is uniquely mandated by the microscopic derivation of the physical current via the Peierls substitution. Notably, we uncover a leading-order failure in standard $k \cdot p$ effective theories for systems with bond-ordered gaps, identifying a need for caution in their application. Finally, we propose geometric engineering as a new design paradigm, enabling the independent tuning of geometric responses without altering the energy dispersion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种与规范无关的量子几何张量（QGT）定义，通过引入包含完整位置算符的协变导数解决了传统计算方法中由于原胞约定（是否包含轨道位置相位因子）导致的歧义。研究表明，通过Peierls替代从微观电流导出的物理QGT是唯一自洽的定义，并揭示了标准k·p有效理论在键序带隙系统中的严重失效问题，最后提出"几何工程"作为独立调控几何响应而不改变能带色散的新设计范式。
AI.motivation: 标准QGT计算通过Bloch投影算符的k导数存在原胞约定（是否包含轨道位置${e^{ikx_α}}$）的根本性歧义，需要解决这一不一致性以建立正确的物理QGT定义。
AI.method: 通过引入包含完整位置算符的协变导数来定义与规范无关的QGT，并通过Peierls替代的微观电流推导进行验证。
AI.result: 建立了唯一自洽的与规范无关的QGT定义；揭示了标准k·p有效理论在键序带隙系统中存在显著失效问题。
AI.conclusion: 提出"几何工程"作为新设计范式，可独立调控几何响应而不改变能带色散。

title: Hidden excimer formation in the gas-phase photodynamics of a BN-doped phenanthrene
comment: Paper: 11 pages, 13 figures; SI: 28 pages, 25 figures
summary: Replacing CC units by isoelectronic BN motifs provides a powerful strategy to tune the electronic structure and excited-state chemistry of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs). Here, we combine multiphoton ionization spectroscopy, time-resolved photoelectron imaging, ion velocity-map imaging, and quantum-chemical calculations to disentangle the monomer and dimer photophysics of 4a,4b-azaboraphenanthrene. The monomer exhibits a structured S$_1 \leftarrow$ S$_0$ spectrum with an origin at $22880 \pm 15\,\mathrm{cm}^{-1}$, corresponding to $2.837 \,\mathrm{eV}$, and pronounced activity in low-wavenumber deformation modes. Photoelectron spectroscopy yields an adiabatic ionization energy of $7.18 \pm 0.02\,\mathrm{eV}$. While the structured spectrum, high fluorescence quantum yield, small computed geometry changes, and weak spin-orbit couplings all point to a long-lived monomer S$_1$ state, time-resolved photoelectron images reveal an additional picosecond component. Ion imaging shows that this component originates from dissociative ionization of the molecular dimer, which projects dimer excited-state dynamics into the monomer mass channel. Computations identify the initially excited dimer state as a bright H-aggregate-like exciton, followed by ultrafast S$_2 \rightarrow$ S$_1$ internal conversion and subsequent structural relaxation toward an excimeric S$_1$ minimum. The experimentally observed $\approx 15\,\mathrm{ps}$ time constant is therefore assigned to excimer formation in the neutral dimer.

AI.tldr: 本文利用多光子电离光谱、时间分辨光电子成像等技术，结合量子化学计算，研究了4a,4b-氮杂硼菲的单体与二聚体光物理。单体S₁态寿命较长，但时间分辨光电子成像显示存在皮秒级额外组分，经离子成像分析发现该组分源于分子二聚体的解离电离，对应二聚体中激基复合物形成的~15 ps时间常数。
AI.motivation: 通过用等电子BN单元取代CC单元，可调控多环芳烃的电子结构和激发态化学。理解此类BN取代PAHs的单体和二聚体光物理行为，对于设计新型光电材料具有重要意义。
AI.method: 结合多光子电离光谱、时间分辨光电子成像、离子速度成像以及量子化学计算等多种实验和理论手段，系统研究4a,4b-氮杂硼菲的光物理过程。
AI.result: 单体S₁←S₀跃迁原点在22880 cm⁻¹（2.837 eV），电离能7.18 eV；二聚体初始激发态为亮H-聚集类激子，经历超快S₂→S₁内转换和结构弛豫，形成激基复合物S₁极小值，时间常数为~15 ps。
AI.conclusion: 单体S₁态虽表现出长寿命特征（结构化的光谱、高荧光量子产率等），但时间分辨光电子成像揭示的皮秒组分实际来自二聚体动力学投影到单体质量通道的伪迹，该组分对应二聚体中激基复合物的形成过程。

title: Levitated nano-trampoline resonators for magnetic field sensing
summary: Levitated systems and high-$Q$ membrane nanomechanical resonators have achieved exceptional sensitivity in precision sensing, but functionalizing such resonators for practical applications without degrading their low dissipation remains challenging. Here, we combine diamagnetic levitation with a high-$Q$ nanomechanical resonator to realize a high-precision magnetometer for sensing weak oscillating magnetic fields. A macroscopic diamagnetically levitated graphite plate acts as a free-floating proof mass that couples strongly to magnetic fields, converting them into mechanical motion that is resonantly amplified by a low-dissipation nano-trampoline resonator. Operating at room temperature and without magnetic shielding, we achieve a peak magnetic-field sensitivity of $4.5\, \mathrm{pT}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ using a resonator with a mechanical quality factor of $Q=6\times10^{6}$ at $443\, \mathrm{kHz}$. The system sensitivity is limited by thermomechanical noise. With further improvements in mechanical $Q$, this hybrid levitated platform offers a pathway toward femtotesla-level AC magnetic-field sensing, establishing diamagnetically levitated nanomechanical resonators as a new class of high-sensitivity magnetometers at room temperature.

AI.tldr: 本文结合抗磁悬浮技术与高Q值纳米机械谐振器，实现了一种室温下无需磁屏蔽的高精度磁力计，峰值灵敏度达4.5 pT/√Hz，受限于热机械噪声，有望通过提升Q值达到fT级灵敏度。
AI.motivation: 悬浮系统和高Q值纳米机械谐振器在精密传感中表现出色，但如何在保持低耗散的同时使其功能化用于实际应用仍然充满挑战。
AI.method: 将抗磁悬浮的石墨板作为自由浮动的感应质量，与磁场强耦合，将磁场信号转化为机械运动，再由低耗散的纳米蹦床谐振器进行共振放大，实现混合传感器设计。
AI.result: 在室温、无磁屏蔽条件下，实现了4.5 pT/√Hz的峰值磁场灵敏度，机械谐振器Q值为6×10⁶，工作频率443 kHz。
AI.conclusion: 该系统灵敏度受限于热机械噪声，通过进一步提升机械Q值，有望实现室温下fT量级的交流磁场传感，开辟了抗磁悬浮纳米机械谐振器作为高灵敏度磁力计的新路径。

title: GHz non-reciprocal optical conductivity in hematite ($α$-$\text{Fe}_2\text{O}_3$)
summary: We study the non-reciprocal properties of the iron oxide $α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$ (hematite) in the canted easy-plane antiferromagnetic phase, specifically in the GHz to THz frequency range. First, using the the microscopic spin Hamiltonian, we obtain the correct classical ground state where the canting is induced by the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions (DMI). The magnon spectrum is simulated using linear spin wave theory. We then compute the polarizability and the sub-gap optical conductivities using linear response. We find that the conductivity tensor contains frequency peaks at the zero momentum magnon gaps of order $0.1~$meV which can be tuned by the DMI and on-site anisotropic spin interactions. Furthermore, we show that the canting-induced net magnetic moment $\mathbf{m}$ represents a measure for the effective time-reversal-symmetry breaking and non-reciprocity of the system: a finite $\mathbf{m}$ results in a non-zero Hall conductivity. Finally, we discuss the prospective application of hematite in non-reciprocal circulator design, by computing the non-reciprocal circulator transmission amplitude using the conductivities as input.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了赤铁矿（α-Fe₂O₃）在倾斜易面反铁磁相中的非互易性质，通过自旋哈密顿量、线性自旋波理论和线性响应方法，计算了GHz到THz频率范围内的磁振子谱、极化率和亚能隙光电导，发现电导张量中存在可调谐的频率峰，并探讨了其在非互易环形器设计中的应用前景。
AI.motivation: 探究赤铁矿在倾斜易面反铁磁相中的非互易光学性质，特别是GHz到THz频段的行为，为其在非互易器件中的应用提供理论基础。
AI.method: 利用微观自旋哈密顿量获得经典基态，通过线性自旋波理论模拟磁振子谱，再运用线性响应理论计算极化率和亚能隙光电导。
AI.result: 电导张量在零动量磁振子能隙处（约0.1 meV）呈现频率峰，这些峰可通过DMI和单离子各向异性自旋相互作用调节；倾斜诱导的净磁矩m是有效时间反演对称性破缺和非互易性的度量，有限的m产生非零霍尔电导。
AI.conclusion: 指出赤铁矿在非互易环形器设计中具有应用潜力，为基于反铁磁体的非互易器件提供了理论依据。

title: Uncertainty Quantification for Free Energy Calculations by Generalized Hierarchical Bayesian Inference
summary: Free energy calculations are routinely used to study molecular processes inaccessible to unbiased molecular dynamics, but their utility ultimately depends on knowing when and how much their predictions can be trusted. Uncertainty estimation is therefore essential for distinguishing genuine physical features of a free energy profile from artifacts arising from limited simulation data or inadequate sampling. Gaussian processes have emerged as a powerful framework for reconstructing free energy profiles together with predictive uncertainties. However, existing implementations typically condition on fixed hyperparameters and observation noise, preventing predictive uncertainties from adapting to the information content of the simulation data. Here, we develop a generalized hierarchical Gaussian process framework that accounts for these neglected sources of uncertainty. Applications to umbrella sampling and extended Lagrangian metadynamics of peptide-lipid membrane interactions demonstrate that the resulting uncertainty estimates track reconstruction errors across a wide range of sampling and data conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种层次化高斯过程框架，用于自由能计算中的不确定性估计，并通过肽-脂质膜相互作用的伞形采样和扩展拉格朗日元动力学应用验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有自由能计算中的不确定性估计方法（如高斯过程）通常依赖于固定的超参数和观测噪声，无法根据模拟数据的信息内容自适应调整，导致预测不确定性不能准确反映真实误差。
AI.method: 提出广义层次化高斯过程框架，将超参数和观测噪声作为不确定因素纳入建模，从而让不确定性估计能够自适应地反映模拟数据的信息含量。
AI.result: 在肽-脂质膜相互作用的伞形采样和扩展拉格朗日元动力学应用中，该框架生成的不确定性估计能够在多种采样和数据条件下准确追踪重建误差。
AI.conclusion: 该层次化高斯过程方法有效解决了传统方法中不确定性估计不准确的问题，提高了自由能计算预测的可信度。

title: Quantum transport in Cooper pair splitters using hierarchical equations of motion
summary: We investigate charge transport in Cooper pair splitters beyond the weak-coupling and Markovian limits. To this end, we employ hierarchical equations of motion (HEOM), which can capture the combined effects of strong coupling to the leads, nonperturbative interactions, and finite voltage and temperature differences. Within this framework, we compute the electric currents as functions of the level positions of a Cooper pair splitter for various voltage and temperature configurations. In the large-bias regime, our results reduce to analytical expressions obtained from a Markovian Lindblad equation. However, recent experiments were conducted with finite voltage or temperature differences, where a Markovian description may not suffice. In this regime, HEOM yield quantitative agreement with the measured currents. We can also account for an experimentally observed thermoelectric effect in Cooper pair splitters. Our results show that HEOM provide a useful framework for describing nonequilibrium quantum transport in Cooper pair splitters and related hybrid devices.

AI.tldr: 本文利用分层运动方程（HEOM）研究库珀对分裂器中的电荷输运，超越了弱耦合和马可夫极限，发现HEOM在有限电压/温差下与实验定量吻合，并能解释实验观测到的热电效应。
AI.motivation: 现有理论多基于弱耦合和马可夫近似，但近期实验在有限电压或温差下进行，马可夫描述可能不足，因此需要更精确的理论框架来研究库珀对分裂器中的非平衡量子输运。
AI.method: 采用分层运动方程（HEOM），能够同时处理强耦合、非微扰相互作用以及有限电压和温度差；通过计算不同能级位置下的电流，并与马可夫林德布拉德方程的结果以及实验数据对比验证。
AI.result: 在大偏压区间，HEOM结果退化为马可夫林德布拉德方程的解析表达式；在有限电压/温差区间，HEOM与实验测量电流定量吻合；此外成功解释了实验中观测到的热电效应。
AI.conclusion: HEOM为描述库珀对分裂器及相关混合器件中的非平衡量子输运提供了有效且实用的理论框架。

title: Zero-field magnetic structure of the antiferromagnetic metal EuSnP
summary: We investigated the zero-field magnetic structure of the antiferromagnetic metal EuSnP through single-crystal neutron diffraction experiments. The magnetic propagation vector in the magnetically ordered phase was determined to be $(0,0,1/2)$, indicating that commensurate antiferromagnetic ordering is realized in this material. The detailed magnetic structure analysis revealed a collinear A-type antiferromagnetic structure with ferromagnetic alignment of Eu$^{2+}$ moments within the Eu--P layer. The present findings provide a microscopic basis for understanding the intriguing magnetic behaviors of EuSnP, as exemplified by the multiple metamagnetic transitions in the antiferromagnetic state and the strong pressure dependence of the magnetic transition temperature.

AI.tldr: 通过单晶中子衍射实验确定了EuSnP的零场磁结构为A型共线反铁磁结构，磁传播矢量为(0,0,1/2)，Eu²⁺磁矩在Eu-P层内铁磁排列，为理解其多级变磁相变和强压力依赖的磁转变温度提供了微观基础。
AI.motivation: 理解反铁磁金属EuSnP的微观磁结构，为解释其宏观磁行为（多级变磁相变和磁转变温度对压力的强依赖性）提供微观基础。
AI.method: 采用单晶中子衍射实验，在零场条件下测量磁结构，确定磁传播矢量并解析详细磁结构。
AI.result: 磁传播矢量为(0,0,1/2)，表明实现的是共线A型反铁磁有序；Eu²⁺磁矩在Eu-P层内为铁磁排列，层间为反铁磁排列。
AI.conclusion: 确定了EuSnP的零场磁结构为A型共线反铁磁结构，为理解该材料中观察到的多级变磁相变和磁转变温度的强压力依赖性提供了微观依据。

title: Property-Guided Diffusion for Inverse Design of Crystalline Materials
summary: Diffusion-based generative models with property guidance have emerged as a promising paradigm for inverse materials design by enabling the generation of crystalline materials with user-specified target properties. However, despite recent advances, the effectiveness of property guidance, its influence on crystallographic symmetry, and the physical viability of generated materials remain poorly understood. To address these questions, we develop a property-guided framework based on the lightweight diffusion model DiffCrysGen using parameter-efficient adapter fine-tuning and classifier-free guidance (CFG). The resulting framework enables efficient multi-property crystal generation while preserving the knowledge learned during unconditional pre-training. Using formation energy together with saturation magnetization and Vickers hardness as representative inverse-design tasks, we systematically investigate the influence of CFG across a broad range of guidance strengths. Increasing the guidance scale progressively steers the generated property distributions toward the prescribed targets while reducing the fraction of lowest-symmetry ($P1$) structures and increasing the proportion of higher-symmetry structures. To evaluate physical viability, generated structures are geometrically prescreened and subsequently validated using a machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP)-based workflow comprising structural relaxation and thermodynamic, dynamical, and property-specific analyses. The framework identifies thermodynamically and dynamically stable magnetic and mechanically hard materials with overall success rates of 12.3\% and 3.9\%, respectively. These results establish property-guided DiffCrysGen as an efficient framework for inverse materials design while providing new insights into the role of classifier-free guidance in crystal generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于DiffCrysGen扩散模型与无分类器引导（CFG）的属性引导晶体生成框架，系统研究了引导强度对材料性质分布、晶体对称性及物理可行性的影响，在磁性材料和硬质材料逆向设计中分别取得12.3%和3.9%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 当前属性引导的扩散生成模型在材料逆向设计中虽取得进展，但属性引导的有效性、对晶体对称性的影响以及生成材料的物理可行性尚未得到系统理解，亟需深入研究。
AI.method: 基于轻量级扩散模型DiffCrysGen，采用参数高效适配器微调与无分类器引导（CFG）技术；以生成能、饱和磁化强度和维氏硬度为逆设计任务，系统扫描CFG引导强度；生成结构经几何预筛选后，使用机器学习原子间势能（MLIP）工作流进行结构弛豫及热力学、动力学和属性分析验证。
AI.result: 增大引导尺度能有效使生成属性分布逼近目标值，同时降低最低对称性（P1）结构比例、提高高对称性结构比例；框架在磁性材料中达到12.3%的物理可行性成功率，在硬质材料中达到3.9%。
AI.conclusion: 属性引导的DiffCrysGen是高效的材料逆向设计框架，并揭示了无分类器引导在晶体生成中的作用机制。

title: Supermoiré-trapped quadrupolar exciton
summary: Moiré-trapped dipolar interlayer exciton in heterobilayers offers a rich platform to explore interaction-driven phenomena. Extending the number of layers to three and beyond leads to highly intriguing multipolar exciton - a superposition state of vertically aligned phase-coherent excitons. However, in experiments, unintentional twist-angle mismatch among layers may degrade the strength and homogeneity of the vertical Coulomb coupling. Here we propose that the supermoiré effect in a heterotrilayer comes to the rescue by creating periodic pockets of vertically aligned atomic registries that facilitate the formation of quadrupolar excitons trapped in such pockets. Using WS$_2$/WSe$_2$/WS$_2$ stack, we show interaction between multiple confined levels of the top and bottom moiré interfaces, creating electric field tunable multi-level hybridized bright (symmetric) and dark (anti-symmetric) quadrupolar states. Our work underscores the critical role of supermoiré effect in quadrupolar excitons. The discovery of reduced sensitivity on precise angle-alignment will ignite exploration of complex excitonic states in multi-layered heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在WS₂/WSe₂/WS₂三层异质结构中，超莫尔效应能够形成垂直对齐的原子级周期性口袋，从而捕获四极激子，并且这些激子对层间转角偏差不敏感，具有电场可调的多能级杂化特性。
AI.motivation: 将双层莫尔激子扩展到三层及以上时，层间转角不匹配会削弱垂直库仑耦合，影响多极激子的形成。
AI.method: 利用WS₂/WSe₂/WS₂三层异质结构中的超莫尔效应，形成周期性对齐的原子级口袋，捕获四极激子。
AI.result: 实现了电场可调的多能级杂化亮态（对称）和暗态（反对称）四极激子，且对角度对齐精度要求降低。
AI.conclusion: 超莫尔效应在多层异质结构中扮演关键角色，为探索复杂激子态开辟了新方向。

title: When Can a Cavity Move a Mott Transition? A Spectral-Density Criterion within Gutzwiller Theory
summary: Can vacuum electromagnetic fluctuations shift a bulk Mott transition? Within the Gutzwiller variational method, we derive a criterion that separates collective spectroscopic hybridization from thermodynamic phase control. We show that a Mott transition shifts only when the electromagnetic environment supplies finite thermodynamic spectral weight with bond-scale variation. A joint frequency--spatial Pauli--Fierz density gives the leading shift. Surface phonon polaritons yield a $d^{-3}$-to-$d^{-5}$ crossover, while finite-coordination variational Monte Carlo supports the predicted critical coefficient and $M/N$ scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Gutzwiller变分方法研究真空电磁涨落能否改变体相Mott相变，发现只有当电磁环境提供有限热力学谱权重且具有键尺度变化时，Mott相变才会发生位移。推导了联合频率-空间Pauli-Fierz密度给出的主导位移，并分析了表面声子极化子的交叉行为及有限配位变分蒙特卡洛对临界系数的支持。
AI.motivation: 探究真空电磁涨落（如真空涨落）是否能够影响或改变体相Mott绝缘体-金属相变的条件和机制。
AI.method: 采用Gutzwiller变分方法推导判据，区分集体光谱杂化与热力学相控制；利用联合频率-空间Pauli-Fierz密度分析主导位移；结合表面声子极化子分析和有限配位变分蒙特卡洛模拟。
AI.result: Mott相变发生位移的条件是电磁环境提供有限热力学谱权重且具有键尺度变化；表面声子极化子引起d^{-3}到d^{-5}的交叉行为；变分蒙特卡洛支持预测的临界系数和M/N标度关系。
AI.conclusion: 真空电磁涨落只有在满足特定条件（有限热力学谱权重与键尺度变化）时才能改变Mott相变，并非所有电磁环境都能产生这种效应。

title: Accelerating grain boundary modelling and simulation by automated pre-evaluation of the irreducible macroscopic representation
summary: A major challenge in the modelling and simulation of grain boundaries (GBs) is the conflict between the system size and computation capability, which inherently restricts the computationally accessible boundary characters. We present an algorithm to find the irreducible macroscopic representation of any given coincident-site-lattice GB character in the cubic lattice, and thus determine the irreducible size of its supercell. The algorithm is compared with the conventional orthogonal supercell and a published calculation method to assess its merits in saving computational resources. This supercell size parameter can be used to predict which GB character is relatively special across the vast 5D space, as those GBs possess small structural units are likely to exhibit particular structure-property relationships that are worthy of attention. The prediction is confirmed by examining the energy and mobility trends of aluminum mixed GBs obtained from the atomistic simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种算法，用于寻找立方晶系中任意重合位点晶界（CSL GB）的不可约宏观表示，从而确定其超胞的不可约尺寸。该算法相比传统正交超胞方法能有效节省计算资源，并可通过超胞尺寸参数预测5D空间中具有特殊结构-性能关系的晶界。通过铝混合晶界的能量和迁移率原子模拟验证了该预测。
AI.motivation: 解决晶界建模与仿真中系统尺寸与计算能力之间的冲突——即计算可及的边界字符受到固有限制，需要更高效的表征方法以节省计算资源。
AI.method: 提出一种算法，用于寻找立方晶系中任意CSL晶界的不可约宏观表示，从而确定其超胞的不可约尺寸；并与传统正交超胞及已有的计算方法进行对比评估，同时通过铝混合晶界的原子模拟（能量和迁移率）进行验证。
AI.result: 该算法相比传统正交超胞方法在节省计算资源方面具有优势；超胞尺寸参数可用于预测5D空间中具有特殊结构-性能关系的晶界（即那些具有小结构单元的晶界）；铝混合晶界的能量和迁移率原子模拟结果证实了该预测。
AI.conclusion: 提出的算法为晶界研究提供了一种高效的计算表征方法，能够识别出值得关注的特殊晶界，有助于在有限计算资源下开展更有针对性的晶界研究。

title: Unconventional $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$ topological order in the kagome XY toric code
summary: We investigate the quantum phase diagram of the XY toric code (XYTC) on the kagome lattice consisting of $XY$ hexagonal and triangular plaquette operators and conserved star operators. We demonstrate analytically by exploiting an exact local $\mathbb{Z}_2$-symmetry on dodecagons that the kagome XYTC realizes a $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$ topologically ordered phase in the limit of large hexagonal \mbox{plaquette} operators. This unconventional topological phase involves 64 quasi-particles - Abelian anyons - with restricted mobility on three colored sublattices establishing a quantum dimension of eight. The large number of topological superselection sectors originates from six independent Wilson loop operators, acting as emergent one-form symmetries. The resulting anyon structure is richer than that of established topological codes like the toric and the color code. A corresponding CSS topological stabilizer code is formulated, opening novel possibilities for the encoding and manipulation of topological quantum information.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了Kagome晶格上的XY环面码（XYTC），发现其在特定极限下实现了具有64种阿贝尔任意子的$\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$拓扑有序相，并提出了相应的CSS拓扑稳定子码。
AI.motivation: 探索Kagome晶格上XYTC的量子相图，揭示超越已知拓扑码（如环面码和色码）的更丰富的任意子结构，为拓扑量子信息的编码和操控提供新可能性。
AI.method: 利用十二边形上的精确局域$\mathbb{Z}_2$对称性进行解析分析，通过六边形plaquette算子的大极限研究相图，识别威尔逊环算子作为涌现的一类形式对称性。
AI.result: 发现$\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$拓扑有序相，包含64种阿贝尔任意子（量子维数为8），任意子具有受限迁移性并分布在三个彩色子格上；存在六个独立的威尔逊环算子。
AI.conclusion: Kagome XYTC的任意子结构比环面码和色码更丰富，对应的CSS拓扑稳定子码为拓扑量子信息的编码和操控开辟了新途径。

title: Crystallization of pristine cubic ice from liquid at ambient pressure
summary: The phase diagram of frozen water is famously rich: to date, over twenty crystalline polymorphs have been identified. Of the low-pressure 'ice I' family, hexagonal (Ih) is the principal form on Earth, while cubic (Ic) is much more elusive. Fundamental questions remain open as to whether cubic ice Ic can form directly from the liquid state, its thermodynamic stability and natural occurrence. Here we show that pristine cubic ice Ic can be formed at atmospheric pressure simply by cooling an aqueous solution confined within mesoporous silica. Using primarily neutron scattering, we show unambiguously that under these conditions, cubic ice Ic forms reproducibly and is the only thermodynamically stable crystalline phase of water. The discovery that cubic ice Ic is directly accessible from the liquid state, and stable at atmospheric pressure, strongly suggests that this polymorph plays a much more significant role in natural and synthetic processes than previously thought.

AI.tldr: 本文发现通过在介孔二氧化硅中冷却水溶液，可以在常压下直接形成纯立方冰Ic，且该相在热力学上是稳定的。
AI.motivation: 立方冰Ic是否可以直接从液态形成、其热力学稳定性及自然界存在性等基本问题尚未解决。
AI.method: 将水溶液限制在介孔二氧化硅中冷却，利用中子散射等技术进行表征。
AI.result: 常压下纯立方冰Ic可重复形成，且是唯一热力学稳定的晶相。
AI.conclusion: 立方冰Ic在自然和合成过程中的作用可能比之前认为的重要得多。

title: Enhanced Curie temperature and room-temperature 50-nm skyrmions achieved in hexagonal ferromagnet Mn5Ge3+x synthesized via a high-pressure method
summary: The development of new high-temperature ultrasmall-size skyrmion materials holds immense significance for the promising applications of topological spintronic devices. In this study, we demonstrate that a high-pressure synthesis technique can significantly elevate the Curie temperature of Mn5Ge3+x crystals, from 294 K to 350 K. This enhancement is attributed to the combined effects of lattice contraction and increased Ge content, the conclusion supported by Density Functional Theory calculations. Additionally, our real-space magnetic imaging reveals the stability of dipolar skyrmions with diameters of approximately 50 nm at room temperature. Our micromagnetic simulations closely replicate the diverse experimental topological magnetic textures observed. Furthermore, magnetotransport measurements indicate the potential for the electrical distinction between various topological magnetic textures in skyrmion-based devices. We also report deterministic manipulations on single dipolar skyrmions in confined nanostructures by using in-plane currents. The observation, electrical manipulation, and electrical detection of room-temperature ultrasmall topological magnetic textures underscore the potential of Mn5Ge3+x as a promising platform for spintronic device applications.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过高压合成技术将Mn5Ge3+x的居里温度从294K提升至350K，并在室温下实现了约50nm的偶极斯格明子，展示了其在自旋电子器件中的应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 开发新型高温超小尺寸斯格明子材料对于拓扑自旋电子器件的应用具有重要意义，但目前相关材料在室温下的稳定性和尺寸控制仍面临挑战。
AI.method: 采用高压合成技术制备Mn5Ge3+x晶体，结合密度泛函理论计算、实空间磁成像、微磁模拟和磁输运测量，系统研究了材料的磁性、拓扑磁结构及其电学操控。
AI.result: 居里温度提升至350K；室温下观察到直径约50nm的偶极斯格明子；通过面内电流实现了对受限纳米结构中单个斯格明子的确定性操控；磁输运测量表明可电学区分不同拓扑磁纹理。
AI.conclusion: Mn5Ge3+x是一种有前景的室温超小尺寸斯格明子平台，兼具观察、电学操控和电学检测能力，为拓扑自旋电子器件应用奠定了基础。

title: Exactness of Symmetry-Broken Self-Interaction Correction in the Strongly-Correlated or Classical Limit: Harmonium as a Demonstration
summary: Strong electron correlation is an important challenge to both wavefunction and density functional theory. It has been argued that the Perdew-Zunger 1981 self-interaction correction to any density functional approximation, after symmetry breaking, can correctly describe the ground-state energy in the strongly-correlated limit in which each electron is described by a highly-localized and non-overlapped one-electron spin orbital. It has also been argued that the classical limit, in which Planck's constant tends to zero, is the strongly-correlated limit of quantum mechanics, where standard density functionals fail badly, as demonstrated by the exactly-solvable problem of harmonium (two Coulomb-interacting electrons bound by a spherically-symmetric harmonic-oscillator external potential). Here we combine these two ideas and demonstrate that, for harmonium, symmetry-broken self-interaction correction is exact in the limit where Planck's constant tends to zero, and usefully accurate for all values between 0 and the physical value (1 in atomic units). We also show that the Planck-constant-dependent symmetric ground-state density can be restored by spherical averaging of the broken-symmetry density.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，对谐波原子（harmonium）而言，Perdew-Zunger自相互作用修正（SIC）在普朗克常数趋于零的强关联极限下是精确的，且通过球面平均可恢复对称性破缺后的基态密度。
AI.motivation: 强电子关联对波函数和密度泛函理论都是重要挑战，标准密度泛函在强关联极限下（经典极限，ħ→0）表现极差，需要寻找能正确描述该极限的方法。
AI.method: 结合两个已有观点：(1) Perdew-Zunger自相互作用修正（对称性破缺后）可正确描述强关联极限；(2) 经典极限（ħ→0）是量子力学的强关联极限。以谐波原子（两电子+谐振子外势）为可精确求解的模型，检验对称性破缺的SIC在该极限下的表现。
AI.result: 对称性破缺的SIC在ħ→0极限下精确；对ħ从0到物理值（原子单位下为1）的区间，结果均有实用精度；通过球面平均可恢复依赖于ħ的对称基态密度。
AI.conclusion: 对称性破缺的SIC方法能正确描述从弱关联到强关联极限的连续过渡，为处理强关联体系提供了有效的DFT修正方案。

title: Ferrimagnetic Skyrmions in a Tetragonal Mn1.9Co0.1Sb Single Crystal at Room Temperature
summary: The development of room temperature small-sized ferrimagnetic skyrmion materials is significant for topological spintronic device applications. As a room temperature ferrimagnetic material, the tetragonal Mn1.9Co0.1Sb crystal exhibits multiple phase transitions, including spin reorientation transitions. However, the magnetic spin textures and their evolution mechanisms during magnetic phase transitions in Mn1.9Co0.1Sb crystals remain unexplored. Using Lorentz transmission electron microscopy, we discovered and verified dipolar skyrmion behavior and its magnetic evolution at room temperature. We established a stable phase diagram of magnetic textures as functions of temperature and magnetic field, while also investigating the evolution mechanisms of spin textures across multiple temperature-induced magnetic phase transitions. Through micromagnetic simulations, a ferrimagnetic configuration with in-plane ferromagnetic coupling and interlayer antiferromagnetic arrangement was established, which stands in contrast to synthetic ferrimagnetic/antiferromagnetic systems that exhibit interlayer antiferromagnetic coupling via the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) interaction. We determined that the intrinsic frequency of ferrimagnetic skyrmions can reach the THz regime due to strong interlayer antiparallel exchange interactions. These findings highlight the diversity of room temperature ferrimagnetic skyrmion regulation behaviors in Mn1.9Co0.1Sb and their dynamic evolution characteristics, opening new avenues for developing novel spintronic devices with enhanced functionalities capable of operating under ambient conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文在室温铁磁材料Mn1.9Co0.1Sb中发现了偶极斯格明子及其演化机制，建立了温度-磁场相图，并通过微磁模拟揭示了层内铁磁耦合、层间反铁磁排列的铁磁构型，证实其本征频率可达太赫兹量级，为室温拓扑自旋器件开发提供了新路径。
AI.motivation: 室温小尺寸铁磁斯格明子材料对拓扑自旋电子器件应用至关重要，但Mn1.9Co0.1Sb晶体在磁性相变过程中的自旋织构及其演化机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 利用洛伦兹透射电子显微镜观测室温偶极斯格明子行为及其演化；建立温度与磁场依赖的磁织构相图；结合微磁模拟揭示层内铁磁耦合与层间反铁磁排列的铁磁构型。
AI.result: 确认了室温偶极斯格明子行为；建立了磁织构的稳定相图；阐明多温度诱导磁性相变下的自旋织构演化机制；铁磁斯格明子本征频率可达THz量级。
AI.conclusion: Mn1.9Co0.1Sb中室温铁磁斯格明子的调控行为多样性与动态演化特性，为开发环境条件下运行的新型自旋电子器件开辟了新途径。

title: Exact Neural-Network Representations of the Motzkin States
summary: Motzkin spin chains are paradigmatic frustration-free one-dimensional quantum systems whose ground states feature exactly solvable combinatorial structures and exotic, area-law-violating entanglement scaling. Specifically, colorless Motzkin states exhibit critical logarithmic entanglement divergence \(\log N\) with system size \(N\), while their colorful counterparts host supercritical sublinear \(\sqrt{N}\) entanglement growth. Such unconventional entanglement behaviors place these states well beyond the expressive capability of standard matrix product states, which are fundamentally constrained by the entanglement area law. Here, we systematically construct exact, training-free neural-network representations for both colorless and colorful Motzkin states across four mainstream architectures, including recurrent, feedforward, convolutional, and transformer networks. Our core design leverages a causal prefix-sum module, implementable via recurrent updates, feedforward mappings, or masked attention layers, combined with position-selective rectified linear gates that enforce the Motzkin height constraints. For the colorful states, we further introduce a dedicated causal stack module that explicitly encodes the last-in-first-out color-matching rule. Our results demonstrate that neural architectures can accurately capture highly non-trivial entanglement features inaccessible to conventional tensor networks, providing prototypic examples for benchmarking and a constructive design framework for future neural-network quantum state developments targeting strongly entangled quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统地为无色和彩色Motzkin自旋链构建了精确的、无需训练的神经网络表示（包括RNN、前馈、卷积和Transformer架构），通过因果前缀和模块和位置选择性ReLU门等设计，成功捕捉了超越传统张量网络能力的非常规纠缠标度行为。
AI.motivation: Motzkin自旋链的基态具有违反面积律的奇异纠缠标度（无色态\(\log N\)，彩色态\(\sqrt{N}\)），超出了标准矩阵乘积态的表达能力，因此需要探索更强大的神经网络量子态表示方法。
AI.method: 核心设计包含因果前缀和模块（通过循环更新、前馈映射或掩码注意力层实现）和位置选择性ReLU门来强制满足Motzkin高度约束；对彩色态进一步引入因果栈模块显式编码后进先出的颜色匹配规则。
AI.result: 四种主流神经网络架构（循环、前馈、卷积、Transformer）均能以训练自由的方式精确表示无色和彩色Motzkin态，成功捕捉了其非常规纠缠特征。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络架构能够准确捕捉传统张量网络无法访问的高度非平凡纠缠特征，为未来针对强纠缠量子系统的神经网络量子态发展提供了原型示例和建设性设计框架。

title: Switchable Altermagnetism via Spin-Induced Improper Polarization
summary: Enabling reversible spin-splitting switching in stray-field-free altermagnets is promising for spintronic applications, but currently limited to a narrow class of polar materials. We propose a broader approach based on spin-induced improper polarization in nonpolar dual-sublattice magnets. We demonstrate this mechanism in DyFeO3, where the product of nonpolar Fe and Dy spin modes transforms as an induced polar mode. Density functional theory shows that the relative Dy--Fe spin alignment selects the polarization, while the Fe sublattice controls nonrelativistic spin splitting, thus enabling reversible switching. These results establish spin-induced improper polarization as a route to switchable altermagnetism in nonpolar bulk systems.

AI.tldr: 提出基于自旋诱导的非本征极化机制，在非极性双亚晶格反铁磁体中实现可逆的自旋劈裂切换，并以DyFeO3为例进行了理论验证。
AI.motivation: 现有的可逆自旋劈裂切换仅限于极性材料，缺乏在非极性体系中实现该功能的普适方法。
AI.method: 利用自旋诱导的非本征极化机制，通过非极性Fe和Dy自旋模式的乘积产生诱导极化模式，结合密度泛函理论计算验证。
AI.result: DyFeO3中Dy-Fe相对自旋排列决定极化方向，Fe亚晶格控制非相对论自旋劈裂，实现可逆切换。
AI.conclusion: 自旋诱导的非本征极化为非极性块体材料中实现可切换的交变磁体提供了新途径。

title: Quantitative Analysis of Composition and Contamination of Atomically Thin Materials by Recoil-Projectile Coincidence in Ion Transmission
summary: Surface contamination strongly affects the intrinsic properties of nanoscale materials, making its reliable identification and quantification crucial for both accurate experimental interpretation and nanofabrication. Although scanning transmission electron microscopy can resolve contaminants at atomic resolution within nanometer-scale regions, it cannot easily provide a quantitative, large-area contamination measure. Here, we introduce a minimally destructive recoil-projectile coincidence method for ion transmission experiments that enables element-specific identification and quantification of surface contaminants with isotopic resolution. We demonstrate this approach by comparing self-supporting graphene samples prepared using either a polymethylmethacrylate (PMMA)-based or a PMMA-free transfer process. Carbon and hydrogen are identified as the dominant surface contaminants. PMMA-free transferred graphene exhibits the lowest native contamination levels. Following in-situ thermal annealing at 400 °C for 1 h, the measured carbon areal density approaches the value expected for atomically clean single-layer graphene within the experimental uncertainty, while hydrogen coverage is strongly reduced. Unlike PMMA-transferred graphene, which rapidly recontaminates after annealing, PMMA-free transferred graphene remains nearly contamination-free for at least 140 min under ultra-high vacuum conditions ($p_{\mathrm{base}} = 2 \times 10^{-8}$ mbar). Beyond graphene, the presented method establishes a quantitative characterization platform for ultrathin materials, enabling studies of surface cleanliness, adsorption, implantation and surface interaction dynamics in such systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于离子透射实验的微损反冲-弹丸符合方法，能够以同位素分辨率对表面污染物进行元素特异性识别和定量分析。通过比较PMMA基和PMMA-free转移的石墨烯样品，发现PMMA-free转移的石墨烯污染最低，且在退火后长时间保持洁净。该方法为超薄材料表面洁净度、吸附、注入及表面相互作用动力学提供了定量表征平台。
AI.motivation: 表面污染严重影响纳米材料的本征性质，但现有STEM方法虽能实现原子级分辨却难以提供大面积定量污染数据，因而需要一种既能定量又能大面积表征表面污染的新方法。
AI.method: 提出一种微损反冲-弹丸符合方法（recoil-projectile coincidence method），用于离子透射实验，可实现元素特异性识别和同位素分辨的定量表面污染分析。
AI.result: 1) 碳和氢是石墨烯表面的主要污染物；2) PMMA-free转移的石墨烯本底污染最低；3) 400°C退火1小时后，碳面密度接近原子级洁净单层石墨烯的理论值，氢覆盖度大幅降低；4) PMMA-free转移样品在超高真空下至少140分钟保持洁净，而PMMA转移样品会快速再污染。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为超薄材料的表面洁净度、吸附、注入及表面相互作用动力学建立了定量表征平台，尤其适用于石墨烯等二维材料的 contamination 研究。

title: Mechanical mapping of thin elastic films and living cells with spherical tip atomic force microscopy probes at large indentations
summary: An analytical model to quantify large indentation force curves acquired on elastic thin films and living cells with spherical tip Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) probes is presented. The model accounts for the bottom effect in the whole indentation range and overcomes the limitations of Sneddon's and Hertz's contact models, which are valid for semi-infinite thick samples, and of paraboloid tip models with bottom effect correction (BEC) that are applicable to spherical tips only for relatively small indentations. The model is experimentally validated with force volume measurements on polyacrylamide (PAA) hydrogel thin films, where an excellent agreement is obtained. The accurate correction of the bottom effect demonstrates that the intrinsic Young's modulus of PAA thin films increases for thickness below a critical value (~15 um). The model also shows excellent agreement with force curves acquired on live macrophages, providing accurate Young's modulus values for these very soft cells (E~200 Pa). Young's modulus values extracted with the proposed model significantly differ from those obtained from Sneddon's or paraboloid models with BEC, whose values deviate by 100% and -25%, respectively. Results show the potential of the proposed model for analysing force curve measurements with spherical tips at large indentations on thin film elastic materials and living cells at the micro and nanoscale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分析模型，用于量化使用球形探针原子力显微镜（AFM）在弹性薄膜和活细胞上获取的大压痕力曲线。该模型考虑了整个压痕范围内的底部效应，克服了Sneddon和Hertz接触模型（适用于半无限厚样品）以及具有底部效应校正的抛物面尖端模型（仅适用于小压痕）的局限性。通过聚丙烯酰胺（PAA）水凝胶薄膜上的力体积测量进行了实验验证，结果吻合良好。模型准确校正底部效应后，发现PAA薄膜的固有杨氏模量在厚度低于临界值（~15 μm）时增加。该模型还与活巨噬细胞上的力曲线高度吻合，提供了这些非常软细胞的准确杨氏模量值（E~200 Pa）。与Sneddon或带BEC的抛物面模型相比，该模型提取的杨氏模量值差异显著，偏差分别达100%和-25%。结果表明，该模型在微纳尺度上分析球形尖端大压痕条件下弹性薄膜材料和活细胞的力曲线测量具有很大潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有AFM接触模型（如Hertz、Sneddon模型）假设样品为半无限厚，不适用于薄样品；而带底部效应校正的抛物面模型仅适用于小压痕范围。需要一种能在大压痕范围内准确校正底部效应的分析模型，以精确测量弹性薄膜和活细胞的力学性能。
AI.method: 提出了一种考虑底部效应（bottom effect）的分析模型，适用于球形尖端AFM探针在弹性薄膜和活细胞上的大压痕力曲线分析。通过PAA水凝胶薄膜和活巨噬细胞的力体积测量进行实验验证，并与Sneddon模型及带BEC的抛物面模型进行比较。
AI.result: 实验验证显示模型与PAA水凝胶薄膜的力曲线高度吻合，准确校正底部效应后发现PAA薄膜的杨氏模量在厚度<~15 μm时增加。模型与活巨噬细胞的力曲线也高度吻合，测得杨氏模量约200 Pa。与Sneddon模型（偏差+100%）和带BEC的抛物面模型（偏差-25%）相比，该模型结果显著不同。
AI.conclusion: 该模型能有效分析球形尖端AFM在大压痕条件下弹性薄膜和活细胞的力曲线，提供更准确的杨氏模量值，在微纳尺度生物力学测量中具有重要应用潜力。

title: From Amorphous to Amorphous-Crystalline Mixed-Phase Boron Nitride: Evolution of the Thermal and Elastic Properties
summary: Amorphous boron nitride (aBN) is a promising dielectric and protective coating, yet its nanoscale heat dissipation and elastic response remain poorly quantified. Here we synthesize a variety of BN thin films by borazine-based chemical vapor deposition (800-1000 C) and study the temperature-driven structural transition from fully amorphous networks to mixed amorphous-crystalline films with embedded BN nanocrystallites.Frequency-domain thermoreflectance data show an ultralow, thickness-dependent cross-plane thermal conductivity for aBN (kout < 0.5 W m-1 K-1 for 10-40 nm), which increases systematically with crystalline order up to 1.5 W m-1 K-1. Micro-Brillouin light scattering and finite-element modelling reveal a concomitant stiffening, with Young's modulus rising from 7.5 +/- 0.7 GPa (800 C) to 53 +/- 5 GPa (1000 C). Green-Kubo molecular dynamics simulations rationalize these trends via bonding topology and vibrational transport, and highlight how oxygen, hydrogen and carbon impurities and composition provide practical knobs to further tune the thermal and mechanical responses in BN films for improving nano-electronics, interconnects and coating applications.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了化学气相沉积非晶氮化硼薄膜的热导率和弹性模量，发现其热导率极低（<0.5 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹）且随晶化程度从0.5升至1.5 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹，杨氏模量从7.5 GPa升至53 GPa，并通过分子动力学模拟揭示了键合拓扑和杂质对热-力学性能的调控机制。
AI.motivation: 非晶氮化硼作为有潜力的介电和防护涂层材料，其纳米尺度散热和力学响应特性缺乏定量研究，亟需系统表征其热导率和弹性模量随结构变化的规律。
AI.method: 采用硼嗪基化学气相沉积（800-1000°C）合成氮化硼薄膜；使用频域热反射法测量热导率；利用微布里渊光散射和有限元建模表征杨氏模量；结合Green-Kubo分子动力学模拟分析键合拓扑与杂质的影响。
AI.result: 非晶BN面外热导率极低（<0.5 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹，10-40 nm），随晶化程度升至1.5 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹；杨氏模量从7.5 GPa（800°C）增至53 GPa（1000°C）；杂质（氧、氢、碳）可作为调控性能的有效手段。
AI.conclusion: 非晶氮化硼的热-力学性能可通过晶化程度和杂质组成进行系统调控，为优化纳米电子器件、互连和涂层应用提供了实验和理论依据。

title: Composition Anisotropy Drives Large Bulk Photovoltaic Fields Along the Non-polar Vertical Direction in 2D Hybrid Perovskite Ferroelectrics
summary: The photovoltaic electric field of the bulk photovoltaic effect (BPE) reflects the intrinsic ability of ferroelectrics to separate photoexcited excitons into electrons and holes, and are essential parameters for applications such as voltage-readout photodetectors. Because polarization defines the cation-anion displacement and noncentrosymmetric axis, the polar direction is generally one of the orientations exhibiting strong bulk photovoltaic field (EBPE). Here, we report emergent BPE behavior in 2D hybrid perovskite ferroelectrics (HPFs), where EBPE can be two orders of magnitude higher along the vertical nonpolar direction than along the polar in-plane direction. Its magnitude is up to orders of magnitude higher than that of benchmark photoferroelectrics across different material systems and is the highest among 2D HPFs reported so far. This strong BPE response with emergent directional anisotropy originates from the unique coupling among the shift-current BPE mechanism, an efficient photocarrier-generating inorganic part, and an insulator-like organic part, a combination that is conflicting or inaccessible in traditional photoferroelectrics. This composition and anisotropy also produce basic BPE behavior distinct from that of typical photoferroelectrics, including a laser intensity dependent photovoltage and a nonlinear scaling of photovoltage with material dimension. We analyze and develop a series of formulas to describe the emergent photovoltage phenomena, which should be applicable to this novel 2D ferroelectrics family and to polar systems with similar anisotropy and robust photoelectric response.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了二维杂化钙钛矿铁电体中一种新兴的体光伏效应行为：垂直非极化方向上的体光伏电场比面内极化方向高出两个数量级，且强度是已知二维HPF中最高的。这种反常各向异性源于移位电流机制、高效无机光生载流子层与绝缘有机层的独特耦合。
AI.motivation: 传统铁电体的体光伏效应沿极化方向最强，但二维杂化钙钛矿铁电体（HPFs）中是否可能存在不同的取向行为尚不清楚，探索这一新现象有助于突破传统光铁电体的性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 实验测量了2D HPFs沿面内极化方向和垂直非极化方向的体光伏电场，分析了激光强度依赖性、材料维度缩放关系，并推导了一系列公式描述新兴光电压现象。
AI.result: 垂直非极化方向的EBPE比面内极化方向高出两个数量级；其大小比基准光铁电体高出数个数量级，是2D HPFs中报道的最高值；发现了激光强度依赖的光电压和非线性维度缩放行为。
AI.conclusion: 这种反常各向异性源于移位电流BPE机制、高效无机光生载流子层与绝缘有机层的独特耦合，该组合在传统光铁电体中无法实现。所建立的公式适用于该新型2D铁电体系及具有类似各向异性的极性系统。

title: SAGE-Net: Semantics-Augmented Geometric Encoder for Material Property Prediction
summary: Reliable structure-property modeling is crucial for accelerating materials discovery, where crystal graphs and structure-derived crystallographic descriptions provide complementary geometric and semantic information. Existing multimodal materials models primarily incorporate textual information through post-encoding fusion, latent-space alignment, or attention-based representation interaction mechanisms. However, in most cases, crystallographic semantics are introduced after structural encoding and therefore cannot directly guide the formation of atom-level crystal-graph representations. Here, we present Semantics-Augmented Geometric Encoder Network (SAGE-Net), a flexible multimodal framework that injects description-derived chemical and crystallographic semantics into geometric message passing. SAGE-Net introduces Semantic-Guided Message Passing (SGMP), which gates atom-level updates and enables crystallographic semantics to directly modulate local geometric interactions across multiple graph neural network (GNN) backbones. Across benchmarks covering bandgap, mechanical, transport-related properties, and synthesizability assessment, the SAGE-Net instantiated with different GNN backbones achieves the lowest MAE on eight out of ten JARVIS-DFT regression targets and delivers strong or highly competitive performance against both structure-based and multimodal baselines. For synthesizability assessment, the SAGE-Net demonstrate outstanding classification performance and high recall rates. Interpretability analysis unravels that SAGE-Net effectively captures physically interpretable crystallographic features, viz. space group, dimensionality, polyhedral environments, among others. Together, these results demonstrate SGMP-based SAGE-Net as a general and transferable framework for deeply integrated multimodal materials learning.

AI.tldr: 提出语义增强几何编码网络(SAGE-Net)，通过语义引导消息传递(SGMP)将晶体学语义注入图神经网络的信息传递过程，在多任务上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态材料模型通常在结构编码后才引入晶体学语义信息，无法直接指导原子级晶体图表示的形成，导致结构编码与语义信息之间存在割裂。
AI.method: 提出SAGE-Net框架，核心是语义引导消息传递(SGMP)机制，通过门控方式将描述衍生的化学和晶体学语义注入原子级更新，直接调控局部几何交互，可灵活适配不同GNN骨干网络。
AI.result: 在JARVIS-DFT的10个回归目标中8个取得最低MAE；在可合成性评估中分类性能优异且召回率高。
AI.conclusion: SGMP驱动的SAGE-Net是一种通用且可迁移的深度多模态材料学习框架，能有效捕获物理可解释的晶体学特征。

title: Hidden Truchet Architecture in Zinc $p$-Hydroxybenzoate
summary: We redetermine the structure of the disordered metal-organic framework Zn(hba) (hba$^{2-}$ = the dianion of 4-hydroxybenzoic acid). Using single-crystal X-ray diffraction measurements, we characterise the structured diffuse scattering that is experimentally observed for this material and which is characteristic of strongly correlated disorder. We use geometric and crystal chemical arguments to propose a general model for correlated disorder in Zn(hba), and then relate this model to a specific realisation of so-called Truchet tilings. Using Monte Carlo simulations, we proceed to show that the model so developed is simultaneously consistent with both the average crystal structure solution described previously, and the structured diffuse scattering reported here. The existence of ordered analogues with different, but related, chemistry suggests scope for control over correlated disorder in this family of metal-organic frameworks. Our study illustrates the potential for a Truchet-tile formalism to help describe and understand more generally the correlated disorder that occurs in framework materials - even amongst those that are chemically and crystallographically dissimilar.

AI.tldr: 本文利用单晶X射线衍射、几何晶体化学分析及蒙特卡洛模拟，重新确定了无序金属有机框架Zn(hba)的结构，揭示了其关联无序本质，并将其与Truchet拼贴形式联系起来，证明了该模型能同时解释平均晶体结构与漫散射现象。
AI.motivation: 重新确定Zn(hba)的晶体结构，表征其特征性的结构化漫散射，并提出一种能够描述该材料中强关联无序的通用模型。
AI.method: 利用单晶X射线衍射测量观测结构化漫散射；基于几何与晶体化学论证提出关联无序模型；通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证模型与平均结构和漫散射的一致性。
AI.result: 所提出的关联无序模型与Truchet拼贴形式相关联，蒙特卡洛模拟证实该模型同时符合平均结构解和结构化漫散射数据。
AI.conclusion: Truchet拼贴形式有助于描述和理解框架材料中的关联无序现象，且该形式可能推广至化学和晶体学上不同的材料体系。

title: Charge-Density-Wave Phase Transitions in Monolayer 1T-TaS2 from Universal Machine Learning Molecular Dynamics
summary: Charge-density-wave (CDW) phases in 1T transition-metal dichalcogenides arise from strong electron-phonon coupling and accompanying lattice instabilities. Capturing their temperature-dependent structural evolution using conventional first-principles molecular dynamics (MD) remains challenging because of the large supercells and extensive finite-temperature sampling required. Here, we combine density functional theory (DFT), universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs), MD, and temperature-dependent effective potential phonon calculations to investigate the structural and vibrational signatures of CDW transitions in monolayer 1T-TaS2. Benchmarking against DFT displacement energies identifies UMA-s-1p1 universal machine learning potentials with sufficient accuracy for subsequent finite-temperature simulations. Our results show that large-scale MD simulations reproduce the experimentally observed phase transition sequence from the low-temperature Star-of-David (SoD) distorted structure to the high-temperature primitive hexagonal structure, as quantified by the number of Ta atoms attributed to SoDs. Heating-cooling cycles exhibit thermal hysteresis, and upon cooling, the system freezes into a multi-domain state in which α and \b{eta} CDW chiralities nucleate independently and persist to the lowest temperatures. These findings demonstrate that carefully benchmarked universal MLIPs can provide a scalable framework for finite-temperature studies of CDW materials.

AI.tldr: 本文结合DFT、通用机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）、分子动力学和温度依赖有效势声子计算，研究单层1T-TaS2中电荷密度波（CDW）相变的结构和振动特征。大规模MD模拟成功复现了从低温SoD畸变结构到高温六方结构的相变序列，并观察到热滞现象和冷却后的多畴手性态。
AI.motivation: 传统第一性原理分子动力学难以捕捉CDW材料的温度依赖结构演化，因为需要大型超胞和大量有限温度采样。本文旨在利用通用机器学习势能解决这一计算瓶颈。
AI.method: 结合DFT、通用机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）、分子动力学（MD）以及温度依赖有效势声子计算，通过DFT位移能量基准测试筛选出UMA-s-1p1通用MLIP，用于后续有限温度模拟。
AI.result: 大规模MD模拟成功复现了从低温SoD到高温六方结构的相变序列；加热-冷却循环表现出热滞现象；冷却后系统冻结成多畴态，α和β CDW手性独立成核并持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 经过仔细基准测试的通用MLIP可以为CDW材料的有限温度研究提供可扩展的计算框架。

title: Magnetic proximity-induced non-relativistic valley polarization
summary: The magnetic proximity effect in van der Waals heterostructures exerts a significant impact on the properties of adjacent materials. Here, we propose van der Waals heterostructures composed of monolayers ferromagnets (FM) and altermagnets (AM), in which the magnetic proximity effect from the FM induces pronounced non-relativistic valley polarization in the AM, and this phenomenon is demonstrated to be universal. Furthermore, by tuning the magnetization of the FM and the Néel vector direction of the AM, four independent valley-polarized states can be realized in the FM/AM heterostructures, exhibiting strong magnetic-valley coupling. These findings suggest that FM/AM heterostructures hold potential application value in the field of valleytronics-based information storage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出铁磁体/交错磁体范德华异质结，证明铁磁体的磁邻近效应可诱导交错磁体中产生显著的非相对论性谷极化，并通过调控磁化方向实现四种独立谷极化态，在谷电子学信息存储领域具有应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 探索范德华异质结中磁邻近效应对相邻材料性质的影响，特别是实现交错磁体中的谷极化调控。
AI.method: 构建单层铁磁体(FM)与交错磁体(AM)组成的范德华异质结，利用磁邻近效应诱导谷极化。
AI.result: FM的磁邻近效应可在AM中诱导显著的非相对论性谷极化，且该现象具有普适性；通过调控FM磁化方向和AM奈尔矢量方向，可实现四种独立的谷极化态，表现出强磁-谷耦合。
AI.conclusion: FM/AM异质结在基于谷电子学的信息存储领域具有潜在应用价值。

title: Mechanisms of Microstructural Evolution and Degradation in Aluminum under High-Damage Irradiation
summary: Aluminum alloys are widely used in research reactor systems, yet the mechanisms governing irradiation-induced degradation remain poorly understood. Here we combine conventional cascade-overlap molecular dynamics simulations with an accelerated Iterative Kinetic Approach (IKA) to investigate defect evolution in single-crystal Al subjected to 50 keV He irradiation. Benchmarking shows that IKA reproduces the essential defect kinetics of cascade simulations while enabling access to substantially higher accumulated damage. By extending the IKA to higher damage levels, we identified three distinct regimes governing radiation-induced degradation in Al: recombination-driven annihilation, defect accumulation, and sink-controlled absorption. At higher damage, Frank loops dissociate into Shockley partials and stair-rod loops, ultimately driving the nucleation and growth of stacking-fault tetrahedra (SFTs). These transformations progressively convert mobile defects into SFTs. Ultimately, the synergistic effect of interstitial and vacancy loops and SFTs increases irradiation hardening in Al at 300 K. This work provides insight into irradiation-induced degradation in aluminum reactor materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结合传统级联重叠分子动力学模拟和加速迭代动力学方法（IKA），研究了单晶Al在50 keV He辐照下的缺陷演化，发现了三种辐照降解机制，并揭示了Frank环向Shockley不全位错、 stair-rod环和堆垛层错四面体（SFTs）的转变过程及其对辐照硬化的影响。
AI.motivation: 铝合金广泛用于研究堆系统，但其辐照诱导降解机制尚不清楚，亟需深入理解。
AI.method: 将传统级联重叠分子动力学模拟与加速迭代动力学方法（IKA）相结合，研究单晶Al在50 keV He辐照下的缺陷演化。
AI.result: IKA方法能够复现级联模拟的关键缺陷动力学，并实现更高累积损伤的模拟。识别出三种辐照降解机制：复合驱动的湮灭、缺陷积累和汇控制吸收。在高损伤下，Frank环解离为Shockley不全位错和stair-rod环，最终形成堆垛层错四面体（SFTs），导致辐照硬化增加。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为铝反应堆材料的辐照诱导降解提供了深入见解，揭示了缺陷转变与硬化的关联机制。

title: Reversible photo-switching optical functionality in two-dimensional mixed-halide hybrid perovskites
summary: Ion migration in halide perovskites is often associated with defects, irreversible processes, and structural instability, making them largely impractical for photo-switching applications. Here, we demonstrate a physical mechanism for reversible, defect-free light-induced halide-ion swapping in two-dimensional mixed-halide perovskites. We find that the halide-ion swapping process arises from strong light-lattice coupling rather than defects. By combining nudged elastic band and photo-force calculations, we show that photo-induced forces perform non-equilibrium work that drives halide ions along the halide-exchange path without reaching the fully swapped configuration. Thus, the cumulative light-induced work can only partially overcome the ground-state activation energy barrier in the presence of light. Analysis of lattice dynamics identifies a few soft phonon modes, two of which are IR-active with oscillator strength $\approx -0.14$ e/(amu)$^{1/2}$, which may be considered the microscopic origin of light-induced halide-ion swapping. This microscopic origin is further supported by band-edge-selective electron-phonon coupling, which amplifies interactions among excited carriers under illumination and with halide-ion motion without inducing a uniform dynamical instability. Using GW (G-Green's function and W-screened Coulomb interaction) calculations, we accurately reproduce the experimentally observed optical absorption spectra in the absence of light, enabling us to describe the light-induced excited state reliably. We demonstrate a clear redshift in the optical spectra in the presence of light, which is due to light-induced bandgap renormalization. Overall, these findings not only establish an intrinsic, defect-free mechanism for photoswitchable optical functionality in 2D mixed-halide perovskites but also demonstrate an intrinsic self-resetting feature in the absence of light.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了二维混合卤化物钙钛矿中一种基于光-晶格强耦合的无缺陷、可逆光致卤素离子交换机制，并通过理论计算确认其来源于软声子模和带边选择性电子-声子耦合，而非缺陷驱动。
AI.motivation: 传统观念认为卤化物钙钛矿中的离子迁移与缺陷、不可逆过程和结构不稳定性相关，限制了其在光开关领域的应用。作者旨在探索是否存在一种无缺陷、可逆的光致卤素离子交换机制。
AI.method: 结合爬坡弹性带方法和光力计算，分析光致非平衡功驱动卤素离子交换路径；通过晶格动力学分析识别软声子模的IR活性；采用GW计算准确复现无光条件下的光学吸收谱，并描述光致激发态。
AI.result: 发现了光致卤素离子交换源于强光-晶格耦合而非缺陷；识别出两个IR活性软声子模（振子强度≈-0.14 e/(amu)^(1/2)）作为微观起源；确认带边选择性电子-声子耦合放大激发载流子与卤素离子运动的相互作用；验证了光致光谱红移源于带隙重整化。
AI.conclusion: 建立了二维混合卤化物钙钛矿中用于光开关光学功能的内禀无缺陷机制，并证明了其在无光条件下的内在自复位特性。

title: Machine Learning Inference Limits of Routine Cement Characterization for CEM I Performance: Evidence From a Multi-Producer Dataset
summary:
Routine cement performance characterization provides continuous quality control data, but its information content for performance inference and transferability across independent producers remains uncertain. This study analyzes 476 cement records from 23 European producers, collected in one laboratory over 27 years, to determine what can be inferred from routine measurements. The analysis focuses on CEM I and combines oxide chemistry, Blaine fineness, particle-size distribution descriptors, physical properties, and derived Bogue and equivalent-alkali descriptors with machine learning attribution and producer-transfer tests.
  For CEM I, fineness is the strongest descriptor family for strength class and water demand, but oxide chemistry contributes a comparable signal when evaluated jointly. Blaine and compact particle-size distribution representations are largely interchangeable within the descriptor space, indicating that the dominant recoverable fineness information is captured by routine measurements. Equivalent alkali shows a consistent negative association with 28-day strength, through K$_2$O in this dataset.
  Strength class and water demand can be recovered from routine cement characterization data. The early-strength designation is recovered only as a population-level tendency, not a physically separable class, because early-strength development can arise from combinations of fineness, sulfate--alkali chemistry, phase assemblage, and plant practice. Producer-holdout tests show that absolute prediction errors remain comparable across the held-out producers in this dataset, whereas recovery of within-producer strength variation is producer-dependent. Routine CEM I characterization therefore supports useful performance inference across producers, while exposing producer-specific variation whose recovery may require additional speciation.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了来自23家欧洲生产商的476份水泥记录，发现常规表征数据（尤其是细度和氧化物化学）可以可靠推断CEM I水泥的强度等级和需水量，但早期强度识别仅为群体趋势而非可分离类别，且不同生产商间的预测性能存在差异。
AI.motivation: 常规水泥性能表征提供了连续的质量控制数据，但其信息含量在不同独立生产商之间的性能推断和可迁移性尚不确定。
AI.method: 收集27年间来自23家欧洲生产商的476份水泥记录，聚焦CEM I类型，结合氧化物化学、Blaine细度、粒径分布描述符、物理性质及衍生Bogue和等效碱描述符，采用机器学习归因和生产者迁移测试进行分析。
AI.result: 细度是预测强度等级和需水量最强的描述符族，但氧化物化学在联合评估时贡献相当；Blaine与粒径分布描述符基本可互换；等效碱通过K₂O与28天强度呈一致负相关；早期强度仅为群体倾向，非物理可分离类别；生产者留出测试显示绝对预测误差跨生产商可比，但生产商内强度变异的恢复能力具有生产商依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 常规CEM I表征支持跨生产商的性能推断，但暴露出生产商特异性变异，其恢复可能需要额外的物相分析。
